blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Spectral variants of low-rank adaptation (LoRA) choose both a subspace and which factor to freeze. We separate these choices by freezing the input factor A A or output factor B B on the top or bottom singular directions of pretrained weights, with learning rates selected separately. At rank 2, the same-band advantage of freezing A A is larger than either within-factor band difference on all four task–model pairs with complete comparisons. Freezing B B also trails comparable-budget free LoRA by 8–18 percentage points on five pairs spanning a formatting task and OpenBookQA. The A-frozen advantage persists in a single-GPU-model replication and within individual MLP module groups, including controls with equal or greater trainable counts for B frozen, and when A is frozen on a random orthonormal basis. The factor contrast weakens with rank. On OpenBookQA / Qwen2.5-1.5B at rank 16, PEFT’s MiCA implementation trails comparable-budget LoRA by 3.08 points under a shared training recipe transferred from the MiCA paper. A trained oracle output subspace largely removes the low-rank deficit; partial warm-up gains recur across three direction seeds. The factor-versus-band ordering is descriptive; an approximate multiplicity audit weakens several earlier significance claims. These results extend known factor asymmetry by showing how its magnitude depends on spectral placement, rank and training conditions.
blocks.zh: 低等适应的光谱变体(LORA)既选择了子空间,又选择了哪个因素被冻结. 我们将这些选择分开,将输入因子A或输出因子B冻结在预受训练权重的上下单数取向上,并分别选择学习率. 在第2级,冻结A的同带优势大于所有四个任务-模型对之间有完全比较的内因带差异。 冰冻B也会在跨越格式化任务和OpenBookQA的5个对子上以8–18的百分点追踪到可比预算自由LORA。 A-被冻结的优势在单GPU模式复制中和单MLP模块组中持续存在,包括控制对B被冻结的相同或更大的可训练计数,以及当A被随机地正统地冻结时. 因素的对比随着分级而减弱. 在 OpenBookQA / Quen2.5- 1. 5B 上进行 PEFT的MICA执行排名为第16名,根据从MICA文件转来的共享培训配方,对应预算LORA的成绩为3.08分. 训练有素的甲骨文输出子空间基本上消除了低等的不足;部分热量增收在三个方向种子之间重复. 系数比波段命令是描述性的;大致的多重审计削弱了早先提出的几项重要主张。 这些结果通过显示其规模如何取决于光谱位置、等级和培训条件,扩展了已知因素不对称。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: LoRA adapts a pretrained weight matrix through a low-rank update B ​ A BA , where A A maps the layer input into a small intermediate representation and B B maps that representation to the output ( Hu et al., 2022 ) . Fixing one factor reduces the number of trainable parameters, but also fixes either the input or output subspace available to the update. A spectral construction makes another choice: which singular directions of the pretrained weight should define that subspace?
blocks.zh: LoRA通过低等更新B ABA来调整预受训练的重量矩阵,A将地层输入映射到一个小中间代表中,而B B则将映射到输出中(Hu等,2022年). 固定一个因子会减少可训练参数的数量,但也会固定更新可用的输入或输出子空间. 光谱构造可以做出另一种选择:预受训练重量的哪个单向应该定义子空间?

blocks.en: Cross-method comparisons can entangle these choices. MiCA fixes the output factor on bottom singular directions ( Rüdiger and Raschka, 2026 ) ; PiCa’s implementation fixes an input-side projector on top directions and shares the trainable output factor across layers ( Hwang et al., 2026 ) . These correspond to freezing B B and A A , respectively (Appendix C.3 ). Comparing them changes orientation, band and sharing at once. Their within-method band ablations, by contrast, hold orientation fixed.
blocks.zh: 交叉方法比较可以缠住这些选择. MiCA在底单数方向上确定输出系数(Rüdiger和Raschka,2026;); PiCa的执行将一个输入侧投影仪固定在顶端方向,并共享可训练的多层输出系数(Hwang等,2026年). 这分别是B和A的冻结(附录C.3)。 比较它们会改变方向、带和分享。 相比之下,它们内部的波段定了方向。

blocks.en: The asymmetry between LoRA factors is already known. Zhu et al. (2024) show that training B B while fixing A A is often more effective than the reverse, including experiments with spectral factors. LoRA-FA fixes A A for memory efficiency ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) , and LoRA+ improves training by assigning a larger learning rate to B B ( Hayou et al., 2024a ) . The question we address is narrower: how large is the frozen-factor contrast relative to the top-versus-bottom spectral contrast, and how does that comparison change with rank?
blocks.zh: 洛拉因子之间的不对称性已经众所周知. Zhu等人(2024年)表明,在固定AA的同时进行BB训练往往比反向效果更高,包括用光谱因子进行实验. LORA-FA为记忆效率A定了A(Zhang等,2023年),LORA+通过给B分配更大的学习率来改进培训(Hayou等,2024a.). 我们讨论的问题比较狭窄:与上下光谱对比相比,冷冻因子对比有多大,这种对比与级别有何变化?

blocks.en: We use a two-by-two design: freeze A A or B B , each on the top or bottom band, while retaining the same pretrained model, data, adapted modules and training budget. Learning rates are selected separately for every configuration. We complement equal-rank comparisons with free LoRA at a nearby trainable-parameter count and a control that gives the B-frozen configuration more parameters than the A-frozen configuration. Figure 1 illustrates the main low-rank result.
blocks.zh: 我们使用二相设计:将A或B冻结在上下段,同时保留相同的预训模型,数据,被调整的模块和培训预算. 每种配置的学习率分别选择. 在附近的可列车参数计数中,我们补充了与自由LORA的等分比较,以及使B-被冻结配置比A-被冻结配置更多的参数的控制. 图1显示了主要低级结果。

blocks.en: Figure 1: At rank 2, changing the frozen factor has a larger effect than switching spectral extremes. Points are mean test scores over five seeds at separately selected learning rates. The free-LoRA reference has rank 1 and a comparable, slightly larger trainable budget than rank-2 B-frozen LoRA. A-frozen LoRA has more trainable parameters at equal rank; Table 3 controls this advantage. The panels use different vertical scales. Lines connect configurations, not training trajectories. Full scores and uncertainty are in Tables 7 and 2 .

blocks.en: At rank 2, the factor contrast exceeds the band contrast on all four complete comparisons. The A-frozen advantage survives parameter-count and module-group controls and does not require a spectral input basis on the two pairs tested. The factor contrast decreases along the complete OpenBookQA rank sweep, becoming comparable to the band contrast at rank 16. Finally, a subspace extracted from trained LoRA greatly improves B-frozen performance, showing that its low-rank deficit depends on placement.
blocks.zh: 在第2级,在所有四个完整的比较中,因子对比都超过了波段对比. A-被冻结的优势在参数计数和模块组控制中幸存了下来,不需要在所测试的两对上进行光谱输入. 因素对比沿完整的OpenBookQA分级扫射下降,与16分级的分级对比变得相上下下. 最后,从训练有素的LORA中提取出的一个子空间大大地改善了B-被冻结的性能,表明其低级的赤字取决于位置.

blocks.en: Our contribution is to separate these design choices under optimization and budget controls and identify the limits of the resulting comparison. Factor asymmetry itself is not new. A follow-up evaluates PEFT’s MiCA implementation under a transferred recipe, without reproducing its original knowledge-acquisition benchmark or evaluating PiCa.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是在优化和预算控制下将这些设计选择分开,并查明由此产生的比较的限度。 因素不对称本身并非新鲜事。 一项后续评估是在转让的食谱下评价PEFT的MICA执行情况,而没有复制其最初的知识获取基准或评价PiCa。

blocks.en: 2.2 Equal rank and comparable budget answer different questions
blocks.zh: 2.2 同等级别和可比预算回答不同问题

blocks.en: An equal-rank comparison holds the maximum matrix rank fixed, but generally gives A-frozen and B-frozen adapters different parameter counts. Summed over all adapted modules, A-frozen adapters at the same rank contain 15.0% more parameters on Llama-3.2-1B and 26.8% more on Qwen2.5-1.5B. This follows from the models’ input and output widths, not from an additional learned component.
blocks.zh: 等分的比较保持了最大矩阵的固定等级,但一般给予A-被冻结和B-被冻结的适配器不同的参数计数. 在所有被修改的模块中,A-被冻结的同级适配器在Llama-3.2-1B上包含15.0%的参数,在Quen2.5-1.5B上包含26.8%的参数. 这源于模型的输入和输出宽度,而不是另一个学到的组件。

blocks.en: For a second comparison, we select an integer rank k k for free LoRA that gives a nearby trainable budget. At frozen rank 2, the reference has rank 1: its count exceeds the B-frozen count by 7.5% on Llama-3.2-1B and 13.4% on Qwen2.5-1.5B. At frozen rank 16, Qwen uses a rank-7 reference, within about 2.5% of the B-frozen count on the two Qwen sizes. Appendix C gives the counts. We call this a comparable-budget reference , rather than an exact budget match. It changes both the accessible update space and rank, so its gap cannot identify the isolated causal effect of freezing a factor.

blocks.en: 2.3 Tasks, models and optimization
blocks.zh: 第2.3条 任务、模型和优化

blocks.en: The central rank-2 results cover five task–model pairs: a synthetic formatting task on Llama-3.2-1B and Qwen2.5-1.5B, and OpenBookQA on Qwen2.5-1.5B, Qwen2.5-7B and Mistral-7B-v0.3. Both frozen orientations are evaluated on four pairs; the formatting experiment on Qwen2.5-1.5B has no A-frozen arm. ARC-Easy and ARC-Challenge provide additional benchmark checks. The complete A/B rank sweep covers ranks 2, 4, 8 and 16 on OpenBookQA with Qwen2.5-1.5B, with rank-16 checks on other pairs. Rank-32 results on ARC-Challenge concern B-frozen configurations only.
blocks.zh: 中央排名-2的结果包括了五个任务-模型对:Llama-3.2-1B和Quen2.5-1.5B的合成格式化任务;以及Quen2.5-1.5B,Quen2.5-7B和Mistral-7B-v0.3的OpenBookQA. 两个被冷冻的取向在四对上评价;Quen2.5-1.5B上的格式化实验没有A-被冷冻的手臂. ARC-Easy和ARC-Challenge提供了额外的基准检查. 完整的A/B军衔扫射覆盖了OpenBookQA上的第2,4,8和16等,并配有Quen2.5-1.5B,并配有对等16等的检查. 排名32的ARC-Challenge的成绩只涉及B-被冻结的配置.

blocks.en: The formatting task transforms CoNLL-2003 sentences into an invented structured output ( Tjong Kim Sang and De Meulder, 2003 ) . Its transformations include rewriting person names, sorting lists, spelling out an entity count and constructing an entity-initial signature. A strict verifier scores whether every required rule is satisfied on 614 test items. This is a measure of learning a structured output transformation, not a general reasoning benchmark. OpenBookQA and ARC use multiple-choice accuracy ( Mihaylov et al., 2018 ; Clark et al., 2018 ) . Each answer option is scored by mean conditional log-likelihood per token; the highest-scoring option is selected. OpenBookQA uses 500 test questions.
blocks.zh: 格式化的任务将CONLL-2003句子转换为被发明的结构化输出(Tjong Kim Sang and De Meulder, 2003.). 它的转变包括重写人名,排序列表,拼出一个实体计数并构建一个实体-初始签名. 严格核查者在614个测试项目上是否满足所有要求的规则。 这是学习结构化产出转变的尺度,而不是一般推理基准. OpenBookQA和ARC使用多选择精度(Mihaylov等,2018;Clark等,2018.). 每个答题选项通过每个符号的平均值条件对数相似来打分;选择了最高得分选项. 打开本 QA使用500个测试题.

blocks.en: Unless stated otherwise, experiments adapt the query, key, value and output projections and the MLP gate, up and down projections in every transformer layer. The standard budget is 600,000 supervised tokens, with AdamW, zero weight decay, gradient clipping at 1.0 and a cosine schedule. The effective batch is 32 sequences of at most 384 tokens. Formatting loss covers the target only; the default OpenBookQA and ARC loss covers packed question–answer text. An answer-only control is reported separately. Identical token budgets imply different numbers of steps and epochs across tasks (Appendix D ).
blocks.zh: 除非另有说明,否则实验会调整查询、密钥、价值和输出预测以及每个变压器层的上下预测。 标准预算为60万个有监督的代币,有亚当W,零重量衰减,梯度剪接为1.0并有余弦表. 有效批次为32个序列,最多为384个令牌. 格式化损失仅覆盖目标;默认的 OpenBookQA 和 ARC 损失覆盖了打包问答文本 。 只回答控制单独报告。 同样的象征性预算意味着不同任务之间的步骤和时期的不同数目(附录D)。

blocks.en: Learning rates are selected independently for each configuration on validation scores, normally using seeds 0 and 1, and test results are then reported on seeds 2–6. Rates span 10 − 4 10^{-4} to 10 − 2 10^{-2} in the main grid, with extensions when a maximum occurs at an edge. The formatting replication on Qwen uses reporting seeds 22–26. New module-group controls use eight reporting seeds, 2–9, and the MiCA follow-up uses a shared transferred recipe rather than separately tuned rates. Selection exceptions, residual grid-boundary cases and hardware differences are documented in Appendix D.3 . Separate tuning reduces a known evaluation bias ( Lee et al., 2026 ) ; it does not establish that every optimizer configuration has reached its global optimum.
blocks.zh: 在验证分数上独立选择每个配置的学习率,通常使用0和1号种子,然后报告2至6号种子的测试结果. 主网格的速率从10 — 4 10 — 4 10 — 4 至 10 — 2 10 — 2 , 当边缘出现最大值时, 扩展 。 Quen上的格式复制使用报告种子 22–26. 新的模块组控制使用8个报告种子,2–9,MICA后续使用共享的被转移的食谱而不是单独调取的速率. 选择例外、剩余网格边界和硬件差异见附录D.3。 分解调子会减少已知的评价偏差(Lee等,2026);它并不确定每个优化器的配置都达到了全球最佳.

blocks.en: Many campaign comparisons were specified in internal version-control records before their corresponding runs, after earlier experiments had already informed the research program. We call these prespecified campaign comparisons , not externally preregistered tests. The supplementary record dates these protocols and lists every historical test with its status. The factor-versus-band decomposition is post hoc, and the rank trend is reported descriptively. An approximate post hoc Holm audit of 145 historical test rows retains 46 of the 109 previously positive decisions. Some rows combine multiple contrasts or reconstruct p p -values from bootstrap intervals, so this is a sensitivity analysis, not a certification of study-wide error control. In particular, the rank-2 OpenBookQA / Qwen2.5-1.5B direct A/B row no longer passes (adjusted p = 0.062 p=0.062 ). blocks.en: Against comparable-budget free LoRA, the top- and bottom-band B-frozen configurations lose 8–18 points on the five central pairs (Table 7 ). On OpenBookQA with Qwen2.5-1.5B, the bottom-band B-frozen score is 42.20%, equal to the unadapted model’s score, while free LoRA reaches 54.56%. On the formatting task, the base model never produces a fully valid output, so the gap measures how well each adapter learns the transformation. blocks.en: 3.2 The advantage persists within MLP module groups
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 MLP模块组内仍然存在优势

blocks.en: The preceding count control still combines modules with different shapes. We therefore repeat the comparison while adapting only the MLP down projections, or only its gate and up projections, on Format / Llama-3.2-1B and OpenBookQA / Qwen2.5-1.5B. All runs use RTX 4000 Ada GPUs, separately selected learning rates and eight reporting seeds.

blocks.en: Within down projections, freezing A A at rank 2 gives fewer trainable parameters than freezing B B at rank 2, yet scores higher on both bands. Within gate and up projections, we raise the B-frozen rank to 8 on Llama and 12 on Qwen: its count then equals the A-frozen count on Llama and exceeds it by 2.9% on Qwen. All eight A-minus-B intervals remain above zero after Bonferroni correction (Table 4 ). Neither total count nor allocation across module types therefore explains the ordering, though geometry can affect its magnitude. In the formatting down projections, B-frozen scores fall to 29.38 and 12.30%; this cannot separate restricted capacity from optimization failure.
blocks.zh: 在下行预测中,第2级的A级冻结比第2级的B级冻结要少一些可受训练的参数,但这两个分数的分数都更高。 在门和上线的预测中,我们把B被冻结的等级提高到了拉马的8分和奎恩的12分:然后,它的计数等于拉马的A被冻结的分数,在奎恩的分数上超过了2.9%。 在Bonferroni修正后,所有8个A-减去B的间隔仍然高于零(表4)。 因此,总数和模块类型之间的分配都不能解释顺序,尽管几何可以影响其规模。 在编制下行预测时,B-被冻结的分数下降到29.38%和12.3%;这不能将限制容量与优化失败分开.

blocks.en: 3.3 Training controls and remaining optimization effects
blocks.zh: 3.3 培训控制和其余优化效果

blocks.en: Three controls test narrower alternatives. On Llama’s formatting task, quadrupling the supervised-token budget and retuning every learning rate reduces the cost of fixing B B , but leaves equal-rank deficits of 12.0 and 18.2 points relative to training both factors. A fresh five-seed replication also retains the large gap; its factor contrast is 15.21 points versus an absolute band contrast of 2.96 points. On OpenBookQA with Qwen2.5-1.5B, supervising answers only preserves A-frozen advantages of 7.2 and 9.7 points. This last control holds the number of optimizer steps and the packed sequences fixed, while reducing supervised tokens by about sixfold; it tests loss masking rather than an equal-supervision training regime. Appendix E gives the measurements.
blocks.zh: 三种控制测试更窄的替代品。 在Llama的格式编制任务方面,将受监督的预算翻了两番并重新调整了每个学习率,降低了B的修补成本,但相对于培训这两个因素而言,排名分别为12.0分和18.2分。 新鲜的五种子复制也保留了较大的差距;其因子对比为15.21分而绝对比为2.96分. 在使用Quen2.5-1.5B的OpenBookQA上,监督答案只保留了A-被冻结的7.2分和9.7分的优势. 最后的这个控制持有最优化步骤的数量和被打包的序列固定下来,同时将被监督的代号减少约6倍;它测试的是丢失的遮掩而不是等效的监视训练制度. 附 录 E给出的测量。

blocks.en: Making both factors trainable from the same spectral initialization also restores most of the performance, including at the comparable-budget rank. Once B B is trainable, however, it can leave the initial band. The disappearance of a band difference in this control is therefore expected and is not independent evidence that the original band was irrelevant.
blocks.zh: 使这两个因素都能够从同一光谱初始化中调整,也恢复了大部分性能,包括在可比预算级别。 然而,一旦B B可以训练,它就可以离开最初的乐队. 因此,这种控制中乐队差异的消失是预料之中的,并不是原始乐队无关紧要的独立证据.

blocks.en: The data also leave room for optimization effects. On the formatting task, fixed singular-value scaling improves the top-band B-frozen score by 3.61 points, and a fixed scalar per module improves it by 2.31 points without changing the accessible subspace. The scalar is determined from the pretrained spectrum; it is not an extra learned parameter. Loss curves continue to decrease at the original training endpoint. These observations prevent interpreting the remaining gap as a measured approximation-error floor.
blocks.zh: 数据也为优化效果留有余地. 在格式化任务上,固定单值缩放改进了顶带B-被冻结分数3.61分,每个模块的固定分数改进了2.31分而无需改变可访问子空间. scalar是由被预先训练的光谱决定的;它不是一个额外的学习参数. 损失曲线在最初的训练终点继续下降. 这些观察阻止了将所剩空白解释为一个测量的近似-误差底.

blocks.en: A separate replication reruns all seven central formatting configurations on RTX 4000 Ada at their original selected rates. The A-frozen advantages are 13.16 and 19.67 points (top and bottom), and the free-LoRA gaps are 12.74 and 18.66 points. All retain their campaign decisions. This removes differences in GPU model as an explanation for this replication, while leaving the historical scores unchanged (Appendix E.1 ).

blocks.en: 4.1 MiCA under a transferred training recipe
blocks.zh: 4.1 MiCA 根据转移的培训方法

blocks.en: Does the rank-16 bottom-band deficit depend on our training recipe? We evaluate PEFT 0.21.0’s MiCA implementation on OpenBookQA / Qwen2.5-1.5B, transferring the learning rate and four-epoch schedule of MiCA’s rank-16 BLOGS configuration ( Rüdiger and Raschka, 2026 ) . We retain our data, 384-token packing, scoring rule and seven adapted module types. This tests MiCA in our setting, rather than reproducing the original benchmark.

blocks.en: MiCA reaches 52.40%, 2.56 points above our bottom-band arm, but trails a fresh comparable-budget free-LoRA run by 3.72 points (Table 6 ). That comparison changes both recipe and training amount. After observing it, we specify and run a second test with free LoRA under the same transferred recipe as MiCA. Free LoRA still leads by 3.08 points, with a nominal paired- t t 95% interval of [ 1.34 , 4.82 ] [1.34,4.82] . The two methods then use the same 417,792 supervised tokens and 272 optimizer steps; free LoRA has 0.79% fewer trainable parameters. This follow-up supports a deficit under one shared recipe. It does not establish the best attainable performance of either method or reproduce MiCA’s acquisition–retention comparison. Appendix C.4 gives the settings and the adaptive sequence of tests.
blocks.zh: MiCA达到52.40%,比我们的下臂高2.56分,但追踪到3.72分的新鲜可比预算自由-LORA(表6)。 这种比较改变了食谱和培训数额。 在观察之后,我们指定并运行了第二次测试,与免费LORA在与MICA相同的被转移的食谱下. Free LoRA仍然领先3.08分,名义成对-t 95%间隔为 [1.34, 4.82] [1.34,4.82]. 这两种方法随后使用相同的417,792个受监督的代币和272个优化步骤;免费LORA的可训练参数减少0.79%. 这一后续行动支持在一种共同办法下出现赤字。 它既没有确定方法的最佳可实现性,也没有复制MICA的收购-保留比较。 附录C.4给出了测试的设置和适应顺序.

blocks.en: 5 Can a frozen output subspace support good adaptation?
blocks.zh: 页:1 一个被冻结的输出子空间能支持良好的适应性吗?

blocks.en: The preceding comparisons could suggest that fixing B B is inherently ineffective. A simple oracle experiment tests that interpretation. We first train a free LoRA at rank 2 on the same training data. For each module, we extract an orthonormal basis Q Q of its learned output-factor space, freeze a new adapter’s B B on Q Q , and train its A A from zero. This is an oracle with respect to access to a trained subspace , not access to test labels.

blocks.en: On OpenBookQA with Qwen2.5-1.5B, oracle directions from two independently trained teachers yield 55.88% and 55.28% accuracy, compared with 46.52% for the top-band B-frozen configuration and 54.84% for a free rank-1 reference retrained in the diagnostic campaign. On Llama’s formatting task, one teacher basis gives 80.81%, close to the five-seed free-LoRA mean of 80.33% at rank 2. These results show that a fixed output basis can support high performance in the tested settings. They do not prove that optimization difficulty is absent for arbitrary bases.
blocks.zh: 在使用Quen2.5-1.5B的OpenBookQA上,两名受过独立培训的教师的甲骨文指示的准确度为55.88%和55.28%,而顶带B-冻布配置的精确度为46.52%,在诊断运动中,免费一级参考的精确度为54.84%。 在Llama的制式任务上,一个教师基础给予80.81%,接近五种子自由-LORA的平均80.33%的排名 2. 联合国 这些结果表明,固定产出基础可以支持在被测试环境中的高性能. 它们不能证明,任意性基础没有优化方面的困难。

blocks.zh: 5.1 联合国 培训前可安排哪些职位?

blocks.en: We compare the spectral extremes with an independently drawn random orthonormal output basis and the top two left singular vectors of the gradient of the training loss with respect to W 0 W_{0} . The gradient is estimated either from 64 training sequences or from the entire training set. All resulting adapters keep B B fixed and train A A ; they do not implement LoRA-GA, LoRA-One or LoRA-SB.
blocks.zh: 我们比较光谱极端与独立抽取的随机正态输出基数,以及W 0 W_{0}的训练损失梯度上的两个左单向量。 梯度估计数来自64个培训序列或整个培训序列。 所有产生的适配器都保持BB固定并训练A;它们不执行LORA-GA,LORA-One或LORA-SB.

blocks.en: Neither random nor initial-gradient placement removes the observed deficit (Table 19 ). Accumulating the gradient over all training sequences does not improve this conclusion on OpenBookQA. On the formatting task, its gain over the top spectral band is 1.79 points, with a nominal 95% interval of [ − 0.84 , 4.42 ] [-0.84,4.42] . This excludes the large recovery seen with the oracle in this experiment, but should not be read as a statement about all gradient-derived subspaces, ranks or optimizers.
blocks.zh: 无论是随机还是初步升级安置都不能消除观察到的不足(表19)。 累积所有训练序列的梯度并不能改进OpenBookQA上的这一结论. 在格式化任务上,它相对于最上光谱波段的得分是1.79分,名义上95%的间隔为[−0.84, 4.42] [-0.84,4.42]. 这排除了这次实验中用甲骨文看到的大回升,但不应被理解为对所有梯度衍生出子空间,分级或优化器的说明.

Dashed lines mark the earlier free-LoRA gaps used as fixed campaign reference values: 8.04 and 12.41 points. Teacher-subspace uncertainty is not included. On the formatting task, the 64-sequence gradient and oracle use a retrained top-band reference, whereas the full-gradient and warm-up comparisons use the original reference; the two reference scores differ by 0.13 points. Full details are in Appendix F .

blocks.en: 5.2 How early do useful directions emerge?
blocks.zh: 5.2 国家 有用的方向什么时候出现?

blocks.en: A short warm-up of a free rank-2 LoRA provides an intermediate diagnostic. After a chosen fraction of training steps, we freeze its output basis and retrain A A from zero over the remaining steps. The total number of steps is unchanged, but both factors train during warm-up.
blocks.zh: 自由军衔-2的短暂取暖能提供中间诊断. 在选定了一小部分培训步骤之后,我们冻结其产出基础,从零对其余步骤重新培训A。 台阶总数没有变化,但两个因素在取暖期间都会起跑.

blocks.en: The original direction seed and two new seeds give the same qualitative pattern: longer warm-up produces larger mean gains at the tested 5%, 10% and 25% cuts (Figure 4 ). At 10%, gains over top-band B frozen span 4.12–4.64 points on OpenBookQA and 6.09–7.79 points on the formatting task. Each of the four new comparisons passes the Bonferroni correction for that family. Nevertheless, none of their corrected intervals establishes recovery of at least 70% of the fixed earlier free-LoRA gap. Appendix F.3 gives the conditional intervals and references.
blocks.zh: 原取向种子和两个新取出种子的质量模式相同:更长时间的取暖在试验5%、10%和25%的减产时产生更大的平均收益(图4)。 超过顶带B的增益为10%,在OpenBookQA上为4.12-4.64分,在格式化任务上为6.09-7.79分。 四个新的比较中的每一个都通过了Bonferroni对该家族的校正。 然而,没有一项经过纠正的间隔规定至少可收回70%先前固定的自由-洛拉差距。 附录F.3给出了有条件的间隔和参考.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Warm-up gains recur across three direction seeds. Each point averages five retraining seeds for one learned output basis. Recovery is the gain over the original top-band B-frozen reference divided by its fixed free-LoRA gap (8.04 points on OpenBookQA; 12.41 on Format). Lines connect three tested cuts; they are not a fitted learning curve. The pattern is descriptive, and values above one can arise because the reference uses rank 1 while warm-up uses rank 2. Corrected intervals for the new 10% comparisons appear in Table 20 .
blocks.zh: 图4:从三个方向的种子中重复产生温暖收益。 每点平均有5个再培训种子,用于一个有知识的产出基础。 恢复是相对于其固定的自由-LORA差距(OpenBookQA的8.04分;Format的12.41分)的原始顶带B-被冻结引用的增益. 线路连接了被测试的3个切口;它们不是一个合适的学习曲线. 模式是描述性的,并且可以出现一个以上的值,因为参考使用第1级,而温暖则使用第1级 2. 新的10%比较的校正间隔见表20。

blocks.en: The full oracle requires a separate rank-2 teacher run followed by adapter retraining. Warm-up keeps the step count fixed but changes which factors train during those steps. Neither is a demonstrated gain in total compute or memory efficiency. Both show that the choice of fixed output subspace can matter much more than the difference between the two spectral extremes.
blocks.zh: 完整的甲骨文要求有一个单独的二级教师,然后是适应者再培训。 暖和保持步数固定,但在这些步数中哪些因素变化。 在总计算或内存效率方面也没有明显的收益。 两者都表明,固定输出子空间的选择可能比两个光谱极差重要得多.

blocks.en: 6 Related work
blocks.zh: 6 相关工作

blocks.en: Zhu et al. (2024) are the closest precedent: they compare the two frozen orientations, study orthonormal factors and report a top-spectral B-frozen result essentially equal to a random B-frozen result on GLUE at rank 16. LoRA-FA ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) and LoRA+ ( Hayou et al., 2024a ) also establish that the factors have distinct practical roles; initialization changes their optimization dynamics ( Hayou et al., 2024b ) . Kratsios et al. (2025) study generalization of asymmetric adapters with frozen random factors. We extend the empirical comparison to both spectral extremes, separately tuned rates, very low ranks and controls that reverse the parameter-count advantage. We do not treat tuning or frozen-factor asymmetry themselves as new contributions.
blocks.zh: Zhu等人(2024年)是最接近的先例:他们比较了两个被冻结的取向,研究正态因子,并报告最高光谱B-被冻结的结果基本上等于16级GLUE上的随机B-被冻结的结果. LoRA-FA(Zhang等,2023年)和LORA+(Hayou等,2024年a)也确定了这些因素具有独特的实际作用;初始化改变了其优化动态(Hayou等,2024年b.). 克赖齐奥斯等. (2025)研究以冷冻随机因子对不对称适配器进行概括. 我们把经验比较扩大到 光谱极端, 分别调制率,非常低的排名 和扭转参数计算优势的控制。 我们不把调和或冷冻因素本身视为新的贡献。

blocks.en: PiSSA and MiLoRA initialize trainable low-rank factors from different parts of the pretrained spectrum ( Meng et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024a ) . MiCA keeps its output subspace fixed ( Rüdiger and Raschka, 2026 ) ; PiCa uses a fixed input-side projector in its implementation together with parameter sharing ( Hwang et al., 2026 ) . LoRA-XS learns a small core within a spectral construction ( Bałazy et al., 2024 ) , while SVFT learns sparse coefficients between pretrained singular vectors ( Lingam et al., 2024 ) . Quercia et al. (2026) already show the value of intermediate components for performance–forgetting trade-offs in spectral initialization. Our interior-band observation is a secondary result about a frozen output subspace, not the discovery of intermediate spectral components. In speech adaptation, SSVD also keeps output-associated singular vectors fixed ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , underscoring the need to limit general claims about the cost of this constraint.
blocks.zh: PISSA和MiLORA从预训频谱的不同部分初始化可受训练的低等级因素(Meng等,2024;Wang等,2024a.). MiCA保持输出子空间固定(Rüdiger和Raschka,2026年;PiCa在执行时使用固定输入侧投影仪并配有参数共享(Hwang等,2026年). LoRA-XS在光谱构造中学习出一个小核心(Baázy等,2024年),而SVFT则学习了被预先训练出单向量之间的稀有系数(Lingam等,2024年). Quercia等人(2026年)已经显示了性能中间组件的价值——在光谱初始化中忽略取舍. 我们的内带观测是冻结输出子空间的二级结果,而不是发现中间光谱元件. 在语音改编中,SSVD还保持了输出相關的单向向量固定(Wang等,2025年),强调有必要限制关于这种约束成本的一般索赔.

blocks.en: LoRA-GA and LoRA-One use gradient information to initialize adapters whose factors remain trainable ( Wang et al., 2024b ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) . LoRA-SB instead trains a small core between fixed factors obtained from an approximation to an initial update ( Ponkshe et al., 2024 ) . EVA and CorDA use activation or context information ( Paischer et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2024 ) . TLoRA constructs a task-aware input subspace from weights and input covariance, fixes A A , and trains B B with additional rank and scale allocation ( Lin et al., 2026 ) . These constructions differ from fixing only the leading left singular vectors of our initial-gradient estimate. GaLore refreshes gradient-projection subspaces during training ( Zhao et al., 2024 ) ; Flora interprets low-rank adapters as gradient compressors ( Hao et al., 2024 ) ; VeRA learns scaling vectors around shared random factors ( Kopiczko et al., 2024 ) . Our negative gradient diagnostic does not evaluate these complete methods. Recent work on factor-constrained continual learning likewise studies how factor constraints translate into effective updates, but targets historical-feature protection rather than our single-task top-versus-bottom comparison ( Wang et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: LORA-GA和LORA-One使用梯度信息来初始化其因素仍可受训练的适配器(Wang等,2024b; 张等,2025. ). LoRA-SB则在从近似到初步更新(Ponkshe等,2024年)获得的固定因子之间训练出一个小核心. EVA和CORDA使用活化或上下文信息(Paischer等,2025;Yang等,2024.). TLORA从权重和输入共变中构建出任务意识输入子空间,修正了A ,并增加了等级和比例分配的B 列车(Lin等,2026年). 这些构造不同于仅仅固定我们初始梯级估计中主要的左单向量. GaLore在训练期间刷新了梯度-投影子空间(Zhao等,2024年;Flora将低等适配器解释为梯度压缩器(Hao等,2024年;VERA围绕共享随机因子学习了缩放矢量(Kopiczko等,2024年). 我们的负梯度诊断不评估这些完整的方法. 最近关于因子限制持续学习的工作同样研究因子限制如何转化为有效的更新,但针对的是历史特征保护,而不是我们的单一任务上下比较(Wang等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: Lee et al. (2026) show that separately tuning learning rates can remove apparent advantages of several LoRA variants. Our own selections illustrate the issue. On Format / Llama-3.2-1B at rank 2, bottom-band B frozen selects 5 ⋅ 10 − 3 5\cdot 10^{-3} , half the top band’s 10 − 2 10^{-2} (Table 14 ). It also selects a lower rate on OpenBookQA at ranks 4 and 8 on Qwen2.5-1.5B and rank 16 on Qwen2.5-7B. Historical common-rate comparisons can even reverse the ranking (Appendix D.3 ). Lee and Lee (2026) identify batch size as another important evaluation axis. Our low-rank B-frozen gaps survive the learning-rate search used here, but batch size remains fixed and not every training configuration is shown to converge. The conclusion concerns the reported training budgets and hyperparameters.
blocks.zh: Lee等 (2026)表明,单独调试学习率可以去除多个LORA变体的明显优势. 我们自己的选择说明了这个问题。 在Format / Llama-3.2-1B的第2名中,B被冻结了,选择了 5 — — 10 – 3 5\cdot 10 — 3 → 3 , 一半的顶级乐队的 10 — 2 10 — 2 → 2 } (表 14 ). 它还在"OpenBookQA"上以第4名和第8名在"Quen2.5-1.5B"上选择了较低的收视率,并在"Quen2.5-7B"上排名了第16名. 历史常见率比较甚至可以逆转排名(Appendix D.3. 李和(2026年)将批量规模确定为另一个重要的评价轴. 我们低等的B-被冻结的缺口 在此处使用的学习率搜索中幸存下来,但批量大小仍然固定,并非每个训练配置都显示会趋同. 结论涉及所报告的培训预算和超参数。

blocks.en: 7 Discussion and limitations
blocks.zh: 7. 讨论和限制

blocks.en: At rank 2, the factor contrast exceeds the top/bottom contrasts on all four complete pairs. This ordering does not extend to arbitrary subspace placement, as the oracle shows. Equal-rank and comparable-budget comparisons control different quantities. Count and module-group controls support the A-frozen advantage, but scalar rescaling and longer training show that optimization also contributes to the measured deficits.
blocks.zh: 在第2级,在所有四个完整的对上,因子对比都超过了上/下对比. 此命令不延伸至任意的子空间放置, 如甲骨文所示. 同等等级和可比较的预算比较控制不同数量。 计数和模块组控件支持A-被冻结的优势,但分级调整和较长的训练显示,优化还有助于计量的赤字.

blocks.en: The strongest evidence concerns Format and OpenBookQA. The larger models are tested on OpenBookQA, Mistral only at rank 2; complete rank-4 and rank-8 comparisons cover one pair. ARC-Challenge shows different higher-rank behavior. We establish neither a universal rank threshold nor a ranking of complete MiCA and PiCa methods. The MiCA follow-up covers one model, task and transferred recipe, without assessing acquisition–forgetting trade-offs.
blocks.zh: 最强的证据涉及"格式"和"OpenBookQA". 较大的型号在OpenBookQA上进行测试,米斯特拉尔只在2级;完整的4级和8级比较覆盖一对. ARC-Challenge显示不同等级的行为. 我们既未建立普遍军衔门槛,也未建立完整的米卡和皮卡方法的排名。 MiCA后续行动涵盖一种模式、任务和转移的食谱,而不评估收购情况——忽略取舍。

blocks.en: Five reporting seeds give limited precision for small effects and ratios. Intervals condition on test items; a seed-and-item bootstrap widened selected Format intervals by 1.8–2.6 times. OpenBookQA lacks the retained predictions for that analysis. Corrections apply within campaigns; the approximate 145-row Holm audit reduces historical positive decisions and excludes the new experiments. The decomposition remains exploratory. Retrospective power calculations often require 3–5-point band differences for 80% detection probability; non-significance does not establish equivalence. Oracle and warm-up intervals condition on each learned basis, and random-basis variability is not isolated from retraining randomness. Rate selection on two seeds adds uncertainty absent from these intervals. The random-A replication was prespecified but not blind to earlier outcomes.
blocks.zh: 5个报告种子对小效应和比率的精确度有限。 试验物品的间隔条件;种子和物品的靴子将选定的格式间隔扩大了1.8至2.6倍。 打开本 质量保证缺乏对这项分析的保留预测。 更正适用于竞选活动;大约145行的霍尔姆审计减少了历史的积极决定,排除了新的试验。 分解还作想. 反向电能计算通常需要3–5分波段相差以达到80%的探测概率;非显式并不确定等同. 甲骨文和取暖间隔条件在所学的每一种基础上,随机基变不从再生随机分出. 两个种子的速率选择增加了这些间隔所没有的不确定性。 随机-A复制被预先指定,但不会对更早的结果视而不见.

blocks.en: Of 137 historical score cells, 86 use RTX 4000 Ada only and 51 mix GPU models; six individual GPU records are missing. The seven-arm Format replication uses RTX 4000 Ada throughout, strengthening that result without balancing other historical campaigns. Protocol timestamps establish chronology within the repository, not external registration. Exact reproduction requires the original data-building, training and evaluation artifacts in addition to the aggregates.

blocks.en: At rank 2, the frozen-factor contrast exceeds the contrast between spectral extremes. The A-frozen advantage survives count and module controls and, on two pairs, a random input basis. blocks.en: The B-frozen bottom configuration follows MiCA’s parameterization: the left singular vectors at the bottom of the pretrained weight’s thin SVD define fixed B B , and A A starts at zero. The scaling, adapted modules, tasks, training lengths and hyperparameter search follow our protocol. The controlled arm reproduces this construction. The separate PEFT follow-up in Section 4.1 transfers selected training settings from Rüdiger and Raschka (2026) , with the adaptations specified below.

PiCa’s Gemma-2B projection ablation is at rank 256, whereas our central A/B comparison is at rank 2. blocks.en: The PEFT arm uses init_lora_weights="mica" , r = α = 16 r=\alpha=16 , fixed B B and initially zero A A . We take learning rate 5 ⋅ 10 − 4 5\cdot 10^{-4} and four epochs from the MiCA paper’s rank-16 Llama-2-7B BLOGS entry, together with its cosine schedule, 10% warm-up, weight decay 0.01, adapter dropout 0.05, gradient clipping 0.3 and batch size four without accumulation. We use AdamW and retain our OpenBookQA loader, 384-token blocks, precision and evaluator. The original study uses a 512-token limit and normally adapts query and value projections; we retain all seven module types. blocks.en: Appendix D Training, evaluation and selection details

blocks.en: D.1 Training configuration
blocks.zh: D.1 培训配置

blocks.en: The backbones belong to the Llama, Qwen2.5 and Mistral families ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ; Qwen Team, 2024 ; Jiang et al., 2023 ) . The main configuration uses AdamW ( Loshchilov and Hutter, 2019 ) with ( β 1 , β 2 ) = ( 0.9 , 0.999 ) (\beta_{1},\beta_{2})=(0.9,0.999) , zero weight decay, clipping at 1.0, bf16 model weights and gradient checkpointing. The cosine schedule uses a 5% warm-up. The effective batch is two sequences per micro-batch with 16 accumulation steps. Setting α = r \alpha=r maintains a scale of one across ranks. Free LoRA initializes A A using the Kaiming construction ( He et al., 2015 ) and B B at zero; neither spectral trainable control modifies W 0 W_{0} at initialization.
blocks.zh: 骨干属于Llama,Quen2.5和米斯特拉尔家族(Grattafiori等,2024;Quen Team,2024;Jiang等,2023). 主配置使用亚当W(Loshchilov和Hutter,2019年)以(β 1,β 2)=(0.9, 0.999) (\beta_{1},\beta_{2})=(0.9,0.999),零重量衰减,剪接为1.0,bf16模型重量和梯度检查. 余弦表采用5%取暖. 有效批量为每小批分出两个序列并有16个积分步骤. 设置 α = r\ alpha=r 维持一个跨等级的分级. Free LoRA在初始化时使用Kaiming构造(He等,2015年)和B B进行A初始化;光谱可列车控制器都没有在初始化时修改W 0 W_{0}.

blocks.en: The supervised-token counter is incremented at every forward pass, and training stops after the optimizer step that reaches the token budget. The accumulation counter spans epoch boundaries, with gradients cleared after each optimizer step. The standard runs require 274 steps (2.76 epochs) for the Llama formatting task, 49 steps (5.76 epochs) for OpenBookQA and 49 steps (14.93 epochs) for ARC-Challenge. Thus the 600,000-token budget is a nominal stopping target and can be exceeded by the final complete step.
blocks.zh: 每次前行都增加监听柜台,在达到象征性预算的优化步骤之后,培训停止。 积分计数器跨越了划时代的边界,每个优化步骤后,梯度被清除. 标准跑需要为Llama格式化任务提供274步(2.76个历程),为OpenBookQA提供49步(5.76个历程),为ARC-Challenge提供49步(14.93个历程). 因此,60万笔预算是一个名义上的停止目标,可以被最后的完整步骤所超越。

blocks.en: On OpenBookQA and ARC, training examples contain the question and the correct answer text, without distractor options. They are concatenated and packed into blocks of 384 tokens. Every token is supervised in the default setting. Evaluation uses the prompt “Question: … Answer:” and scores each candidate answer by score ⁡ ( a ∣ q ) = 1 | a | ​ ∑ t = 1 | a | log ⁡ p ⁡ ( a t ∣ q , a < t ) . \operatorname{score}(a\mid q)=\frac{1}{|a|}\sum_{t=1}^{|a|}\log p(a_{t}\mid q,a_{<t}). The reported metric is the fraction of questions for which the highest-scoring candidate is correct. Training uses each benchmark’s own training split. Public benchmark scores do not constitute a guarantee against pretraining contamination.
D.2 Formatting task and verifier
blocks.zh: D.2 任务和核查的格式

blocks.en: Sentences are drawn from CoNLL-2003 and retained when they contain at least three entities. Targets require person names in last-name-first order, alphabetically sorted lists, an entity count written in words, and entity initials in document order. The verifier enforces tags, single-line JSON, the required keys and their order, and the target’s transformation rules. A generation passes only if all checks succeed. The task therefore combines entity handling, transformations and serialization; “valid-format accuracy” is stricter than merely syntactic JSON validity.
blocks.zh: 刑期取自CONLL-2003,如果至少包含三个实体,则保留。 目标需要上名第一顺序的人名,按字母排序的列表,用单词书写的实体计数,以及按文档顺序书写的实体首字母. 核查者执行标记,单行JSON,所需密钥及其顺序,以及目标转换规则. 只有所有检查都成功,一代人才能通过。 因此,这项任务将实体处理、转换和序列化结合起来;“有效格式的准确性”比仅仅综合JSON的有效性更为严格。

blocks.en: The training set used by the full-gradient diagnostic contains 3,178 sequences. Evaluation generates at most 128 tokens on 614 test items. Across main rank-2 configurations, 0.7–0.9% of generations reach that limit. Component-level checks place the larger bottom-band deficits in the signature and entity-count fields rather than the presence of keys. Exact reproduction of this custom metric requires the data generator, prompt template, split manifest and verifier implementation, not merely the verbal description.

Five repetitions matched the original score exactly; the other ten moved by − 2.6 -2.6 to + 3.6 +3.6 points, with a mean change of + 0.1 +0.1 . This is consistent with run variability but does not by itself prove the absence of an earlier verifier difference.

blocks.en: Appendix F Placement diagnostics: scores, references and uncertainty

blocks.en: A geometric diagnostic uses saved rank-1 free-LoRA factors from five seeds on OpenBookQA / Qwen2.5-1.5B and Format / Llama-3.2-1B. Its reading rule was fixed before the OpenBookQA measurement and applied post hoc to Format (supplementary record, §S15, phase 1). A module type is classified as outside both tested rank-2 bands when its output-factor energy share in each band is below five times the isotropic reference 2 / d out 2/d_{\mathrm{out}} , using layer medians averaged over seeds. Six of seven module types satisfy this rule on both pairs. The key projection is more aligned with the bottom band, but its energy share remains only 6.1% on OpenBookQA and 2.5% on Format. Thus the learned output factors are not concentrated in either tested extreme. This classification does not mean zero spectral overlap, and the strict all-seven-module trigger for the oracle follow-up was not met (Appendix F.2 ). It motivates testing learned placements but does not by itself explain their performance.

blocks.zh: 控制重跑将实际参考差改为8.32和12.57分. 在"OpenBookQA"上,再运行下B被冻结得分42.76%;格式化记录引用了下行59.05%和随机正态66.31%. 后来的出处审计无法识别出所引用的59.05%底分的运行设置,这在主要对比度中没有使用. 主比保留了原来的固定分母,因此这些再运行的值决不能默默地被替换为它. 超过一个比率是可能的,不衡量概率或效率优势。

blocks.en: G.1 Unit of uncertainty and families of comparisons
blocks.zh: G.1 联合国 不确定的单位和比较的家族

The two-band controls use the more stringent decision threshold t 0.9875 , 4 ≃ 3.495 t_{0.9875,4}\simeq 3.495 for a two-sided familywise 0.05 comparison. A nominal interval excluding zero is not by itself the corrected decision rule. Tables state when such a rule applies. The factor/band summaries instead retain the original post hoc paired percentile-bootstrap intervals; we do not reconstruct seed-level samples from aggregate scores.

blocks.en: Pairing by seed preserves the study’s matched-run structure. It does not remove a systematic GPU imbalance, or propagate the variability of an earlier rate-selection stage. The finite test sample is treated as fixed in the principal analyses. A separate two-level bootstrap on the formatting task resamples seeds and test items; for selected band contrasts and their interaction, intervals widen by 1.8–2.6 times. The B-frozen band contrast and interaction remain nonzero in that check, while the A-frozen band contrast does not. OpenBookQA did not retain the per-question predictions needed for the analogous paired item-level reanalysis.
blocks.zh: 种子配对保持了研究的匹配结构。 它没有消除系统性的GPU不平衡,也没有宣传较早的费率选择阶段的可变性. 有限试验样品按主要分析确定的处理。 在格式化任务上单独设置了双级的靴子,重新标出种子和测试项目;对于选定的带状对比及其相互作用,间隔会扩大1.8至2.6倍。 B-冻带对比和相互作用在该检查中保持非零,而A-冻带对比则没有. 打开本 质量保证没有保留类似对子项目级再分析所需的每问题预测。

blocks.zh: 表21:证据地图。 文件的主要经验性主张不能仅仅因为一些基本运动事先规定了协议而继承确认地位。

blocks.en: G.2 Approximate multiplicity audit of the historical record
blocks.zh: G.2 对历史记录的大致多重审计

blocks.en: A post hoc audit applies Holm’s step-down calculation at 0.05 to 145 rows of the earlier campaign test inventory. The inventory starts from 151 rows, excludes four descriptive rows and two selection outcomes, and counts a row once even when it contains several quantities. This population is larger than the comparisons retained in this manuscript and excludes the new training campaigns. The 151 inventory rows are in Tables S24–S27 of the supplementary record. Removing the four descriptive rows and two selection outcomes gives the 145 audited rows.
blocks.zh: 事后审计采用霍尔姆在较早的竞选测试盘点中0.05至145行的下行计算. 库存从151行开始,不包括4行描述和2个选择结果,即使包含数个数量也算一行。 这一数字大于本手稿中所作的比较,不包括新的培训活动。 151行库存列于补充记录表S24-S27。 删除四行说明和两行选择结果后,可得出145行审计结果。

blocks.en: For reported t t statistics, the audit reconstructs p p -values using the recorded degrees of freedom and sidedness. For percentile-bootstrap intervals it instead estimates a standard error from the distance to the relevant endpoint divided by 1.96, then uses a normal tail. Other interval-based decisions are inverted using their stated thresholds. Rows without a statistical test receive p = 1 p=1 while remaining explicitly outside inferential interpretation. If a row originally declared several components positive, the largest of their p p -values is used; otherwise the smallest component value is used. One interval-based row also selects the smaller of two one-sided values. These data-dependent aggregation rules and approximate conversions prevent interpreting the output as rigorous error control over all underlying hypotheses.
blocks.zh: 对于报告的tt统计,审计利用记录的自由度和侧面度重构p-p值. 对于百分位-bootstrap间隔,它反而估计出从相距到相关端点除以1.96的标准出错,然后使用正常的尾巴. 其他以间隔为基础的决定则使用其规定的阈值进行倒置。 未进行统计测试的行收到p=1 p=1,同时明确保留在暗示解释之外. 如果一行最初声明数个组件为正数,则使用其p-值中最大的;否则使用最小的组件值. 一个基于间隔的行也选择两个单面值中较小的. 这些数据依赖的聚合规则和相近的转换阻止了将输出解释为对所有基础假设的严格错误控制.

blocks.en: Under that calculation, 46 of 109 previously positive row decisions remain below 0.05, and 63 do not. The A-frozen advantages on Format / Llama and on both 7B models are retained, along with the Qwen-7B parameter-count control. The direct rank-2 Qwen-1.5B OpenBookQA row and its parameter-count control each have adjusted p = 0.062 p=0.062 . The rank-8 and rank-16 A/B rows and the answer-only row also fail this global sensitivity threshold. The components originally declared positive in the five factor/band decomposition rows survive under the interval approximation; this does not supply a new test of F > | S | F>|S| .
blocks.zh: 根据这一计算,在先前109项正行判决中,46项仍然低于0.05,63项没有。 保留了Format / Llama和两个7B模型的A-冻结优势,同时保留了Quen-7B参数计数控制. 直接等级-2 Quen-1.5B OpenBookQA行及其参数计数控制各有调整p=0.062 p=0.062. 8等和16等A/B行和只答行也辜负了这个全球敏感门槛. 最初在五因子/波段分解行中被宣布为正数的组件在间隔近似下存活;这并不能提供F > QQS FQQSXXXXXX的新测试.

blocks.en: The transcription check finds one inconsistent original verdict, a row combining two tests with different thresholds. Six interval-converted rows lie near the Holm threshold. We therefore report the audit as sensitivity evidence and retain the original effect sizes and campaign-specific intervals, rather than relabeling every claim as globally confirmed. At the first Holm step, p ≤ 0.05 / 145 p\leq 0.05/145 corresponds to | t | ≥ 11.34 |t|\geq 11.34 for a two-sided test with four degrees of freedom (9.48 for a one-sided test); the threshold varies with degrees of freedom and step.
blocks.zh: 抄录检查发现一个不一致的原判,一行将两个测试与不同的阈值结合起来. 6个间隔被转换的行位于霍尔姆阈值附近. 因此,我们将审计报告为敏感性证据,并保留最初的影响大小和具体活动间隔,而不是将每一项主张重新贴上全球确认的标签。 在第一个霍尔姆步骤上,p 0.05/145 p\leq 0.05/145对应 |t ≥ 11.34 |t|\geq 11.34 为双侧测试,自由度为4度(9.48为单侧测试);阈值随自由度和步数而变化.

blocks.en: G.3 Sensitivity of small band comparisons
blocks.zh: G.3 小型波段比较的敏感性

blocks.en: For historical band comparisons that did not pass their campaign criterion, we estimate the minimum detectable effect (MDE) at 80% power. For a paired- t t test this is the mean difference required by a noncentral- t t power calculation, using the observed standard deviation of seed-paired differences and the original significance level. These are retrospective sensitivity estimates with uncertain variance inputs, not proof that an undetected effect exists.
blocks.zh: 对于没有通过运动标准的历史波段比较,我们估计最小可探测效应为80%的功率. 对于一对-t t测试,这是非中-t功率计算所需的平均差值,使用所观察到的种子-培植差异的标准差和原始意义级. 这些是具有不确定差异输入的回溯性敏感度估计,而不是存在未发现效应的证据.

blocks.en: Table 22: Selected retrospective sensitivity estimates (percentage points). Historical selection rules and seed sets are retained. These rows are not all drawn from the central separately tuned two-by-two comparisons.
blocks.zh: 表22: 选定的追溯性敏感性估计数(百分比分)。 保留历史选取规则和种子集. 这些行并非都取自中央单独调制的二相比较.

blocks.en: Many five-to-eight-seed comparisons require 3–5 points for 80% power, although the range is wider across the full audit. Two older predicted bottom-band advantages instead have negative estimates: − 2.88 -2.88 points on rank-2 OpenBookQA (MDE 3.25) and − 2.90 -2.90 on ARC-Easy (MDE 1.02). Their sign contradicts the prediction; this is distinct from merely failing to detect a small positive gain. These are separate historical contrasts, not the band differences of the central table. The MDE alone is not a significance test of the reverse ordering.
blocks.zh: 许多5到8个种子的比较需要3到5分才能达到80%的功率,尽管在整个审计中范围更广. 两种较早的预测底带优势有负估计:- 2.88-2.88分在平分-2 OpenBookQA (MDE 3.25)上;- 2.90-2.90分在ARC-Easy (MDE 1.02)上. 他们的标志与预测相矛盾;这不同于仅仅未能发现微小的正增益. 这些是独立的历史对比,而不是中央台的波段差异. 单是MDE并不是反向订单的重要测试.

blocks.en: Two rows use normal approximations to bootstrap widths rather than noncentral- t t inversion: the rank-2 spectral-position contrast (MDE 5.93 points) and the Mistral band component (1.99 points). Two further rows lack a reported mean difference and retain standardized MDEs only, 2.48 and 1.68. These declared limitations, and the use of observed rather than prospectively specified variability, rule out interpreting non-significance as equivalence.
blocks.zh: 两行使用正常相近来表示靴子的宽度,而不是非中-t t倒置:平分-2光谱-位置对比(MDE 5.93分)和米斯特尔带部分(1.99分). 还有两行没有报告的平均差额,只保留标准化的MDE,即2.48和1.68。 这些已宣布的限制,以及使用观察到的、而不是预期指定的可变性,排除了将无分量解释为等同性。

blocks.en: G.4 Why recovery is not a causal decomposition
blocks.zh: G.4 联合国 为什么恢复不是因果分解

blocks.en: Earlier campaign summaries used G = L − b G=L-b , R = u − b R=u-b and I = L − u I=L-u , where L L is free LoRA at the reference rank, u u is a both-trainable spectral initialization at that rank, and b b is a B-frozen score at the larger frozen rank. The identity G = R + I G=R+I holds by construction. It does not establish that R R is a separately identified causal contribution of freezing, because moving from b b to u u also changes rank, parameterization and trainable count.
blocks.zh: 早期的竞选摘要使用G=L-b G=L-b,R=u-b和I=L=u-b,其中L为参考级别下的自由LORA,u为该级别下双能光谱初始化,而b为较大被冻结级别下B-冻结分. 身份 G = R + I G = R + I 通过建筑持有. 它没有确定RR是被单独确认的被冻结的因果贡献,因为从bb到uu也改变等级,参数化和可训练计数.

blocks.en: The original recovery criterion asks whether a nominal interval for R R lies above 0.7 ​ G 0 0.7G_{0} , with G 0 G_{0} fixed from an earlier campaign and a two-point floor. This tests performance against a fixed numerical benchmark. It does not propagate uncertainty or covariance in an estimated G G , and is not a test of R − 0.7 ​ G R-0.7G under joint sampling. Its strongest interpretation is that spectral initialization need not prevent a trainable adapter from approaching the free reference. The paper therefore places direct A/B comparisons and the parameter-count reversal ahead of this statistic.
blocks.zh: 最初的回收标准询问RR的标称间隔是否高于0.7 G 0 0.7G_{0},其中G 0 G_{0}固定在更早的一次竞选和两分楼. 这对照固定数字基准检验业绩。 它不会在估计的GG中传播不确定性或共性,也不是在联合取样下对R−0.7G R−0.7G的测试. 它最强的解释是光谱初始化不需要阻止可被训练的适配器接近自由参考. 因此,该文件将直接的A/B比较和参数倒数放在这一统计之前。

blocks.en: G.5 Prospective records and deviations
blocks.zh: G.5 未来记录和偏差

blocks.en: Internal protocols specify configurations, seeds, thresholds and interpretations for many campaigns before the corresponding runs. The larger-model comparisons, fresh-seed replication, parameter reversal, rank extension, accumulated gradient, warm-up and answer-only controls have such records. Earlier findings informed which campaigns were proposed, and some records were committed shortly before launch. These are local version-control timestamps, not external immutable registrations. Table R1 of the supplementary record dates the protocols of the earlier campaigns.
blocks.zh: 内部协议在相应的运行前为许多运动指定了配置,种子,阈值和解释. 较大的模型比较,新种子复制,参数倒转,分级扩展,累积梯度,取暖和只回答控制都有这样的记录. 较早的调查结果通报了提议开展哪些运动,一些记录在发射前不久就作了。 这些是本地版本的控制时间戳,而不是外部不可改变的注册. 补充记录的表R1是先前运动的协议日期。

blocks.en: The broader campaign history includes reused runs, revised selections and machine-failure relaunches. A rank-8 Llama selection was replaced with fresh selection seeds 40–41 and reporting seeds 42–46 after an earlier unregistered sweep. The Qwen formatting replication uses seeds 22–26. Some exploratory common-rate and position comparisons reused earlier runs; they are not promoted to confirmatory evidence here. The oracle launch deviation is described in Appendix F . The new records and departures are summarized below; protocol counts do not make the post hoc synthesis confirmatory.
blocks.zh: 更广阔的竞选历史包括再利用跑道、修改选择和机器故障重新启动。 8级的Llama选取被替换为新鲜选取种子40-41并报告种子42-46。 Quen格式的复制使用种子22–26. 一些探索性的共同率和位置比较以前重复使用过;此处不将其推广为确认性证据。 甲骨文发射偏差的说明见附录F。 新的记录和去处概述如下;协议计数不能使事后综合确认。

blocks.en: The aggregation procedure checks evaluation size, adapted modules, clipping, norm rescaling, verifier version, random-subspace draw salt, model and LoRA scale before combining runs. Early data failed this check and were separated or replaced. It is a consistency check on recorded configurations, not a substitute for independent reproduction.
blocks.zh: 汇总程序在组合运行前会检查评价大小,被调整的模块,剪接,规范缩放,验证版,随机-子空间绘图盐,模型和LORA比例. 早期数据未能通过此检查, 并被分隔或替换 。 这是对已记录配置的一致性检查,而不是独立复制的替代.

blocks.en: Table 23: Internal prospective records for the new training campaigns. According to the retained records, protocols preceded their new runs. The random-A addendum was pushed after selection submission but before any result. The shared-recipe test was planned after the first MiCA result.
blocks.zh: 表23:新培训活动的内部预期记录。 根据保留记录,协议在新运行之前。 随机-A增编是在提交甄选报告后推后推后推后推后推后取出任何结果。 共享-recipe测试是在第一个MICA结果后规划的.

blocks.en: The no-training audits are explicitly post hoc. GPU attribution required two declared revisions after its initial execution: configuration grouping was corrected, then ambiguous rounded means were resolved from their table row and column. The final mapping was pushed on 3 October 2026 at 09:13. Matching a rounded score alone is insufficient: several distinct configurations share the same four-decimal mean. For two sensitivity rows, standardized effects replace the planned recovery of run-level variances because the corresponding cells could not be identified reliably.
blocks.zh: 无培训审计显然属于临时审计。 GPU归属在初始执行后需要两次宣布的修订:配置分组被纠正,然后从他们的表格行和列中解决了模糊的四舍五入方式. 最终测绘于2026年10月3日09:13被推开. 单独匹配一个四舍五入的分数是不够的:几个不同的配置共享相同的四小数平均值. 对于两个敏感行,标准化效果取代了计划回收的运行级别差异,因为无法可靠地识别出相应的单元格.

blocks.en: G.6 Hardware, retained artifacts and compute
blocks.zh: G.6 硬件、保留文物和计算

blocks.en: Training uses a shared cluster with RTX 4000 Ada, RTX 2000 Ada, RTX A5000, RTX A4000 and GeForce RTX 3090 GPUs. The final audit identifies 137 distinct historical score cells, classifying 86 as RTX 4000 Ada only and 51 as mixed-GPU. It resolves 133 of 134 distinct recorded score values. Its per-run counts are 577 RTX 4000 Ada, 39 RTX 3090, 33 RTX 2000 Ada, 27 RTX A5000 and 23 RTX A4000, with six missing records: three each in the original rank-2 Format B-top and B-bottom cells. These counts sum to 705 records, of which 699 have a known GPU; 577/699 is 82.5%. Classification follows available metadata, and assignment is not balanced retrospectively. The unmatched score is the 59.05% formatting bottom control quoted in an earlier diagnostic caption. Parameter-reversal and rank-extension campaigns use RTX 4000 Ada throughout, as do the 681 follow-up runs preceding the random-A replication. The seven-arm formatting replication directly addresses the two central cells with missing records (Appendix E.1 ). Re-evaluation on the original GPU model reproduced the checked scores, whereas 11 of 12 re-evaluations on another GPU model differed; observed shifts were 0.2–1.8 points. This association is consistent with hardware-dependent numerical behavior, but does not isolate its exact kernel-level cause. Seed variation captures random hardware effects only to the extent that assignment varies appropriately; it cannot rule out systematic confounding.
blocks.zh: 训练使用与RTX 4000 Ada,RTX 2000 Ada,RTX A5000,RTX A400和GeForce RTX 3090 GPU共享集群. 最终审计确定了137个截然不同的历史得分格,将86个仅被归类为RTX 4000 Ada,51个被归类为混合GPU. 它解决了134个不同记录分数中的133个. 其按跑计分有577个RTX 4000 Ada,39个RTX 3090,33个RTX 2000 Ada,27个RTX A5000和23个RTX A4000,有6个缺失记录: 3个在原排名-2格式B-上下层和B-下层的细胞中. 这些记录共计705个,其中699个有已知的GPU;577/699是82.5%。 分类是按照现有元数据进行的,任务没有追溯平衡。 无法匹配的分数是59.05%格式化了先前诊断标题所引用的底层控制. 参数反转和分级扩展运动在整个过程中使用RTX 4000 Ada,在随机-A复制之前的681次后续活动也是如此。 七臂格式化复制直接解决了缺少记录的两个中央单元格(附录E.1. 对原GPU模型的再评价照搬了所检查的分数,而在对另一个GPU模型的12个再评价中,有11个有差异;观察到的变化为0.2-1.8分. 这种关联与硬件依赖的数值行为一致,但并不孤立其精确的内核级原因. 种子变异仅能捕捉到随机硬件效果,只要任务有适当的差异;它不能排除系统性的混淆.

blocks.en: Runs failing an SVD reconstruction check were excluded before training. Two earlier runs on a subsequently suspect node were repeated elsewhere and replaced under a rule fixed before inspecting replacement scores. Memory failures caused by concurrent cluster use also led to relaunches. Factors were not retained for every extension run because of storage constraints, limiting retrospective geometric analyses.
blocks.zh: 未进行 SVD 重建检查的运行在培训前被排除 。 先前对后来一个可疑节点的两次运行在其他地方重复,并在检查替换分数之前按照固定规则替换。 同时使用集群造成的内存故障也导致重新启动。 由于储存的限制,限制追溯几何分析,因此没有为每次延长都保留因素。

blocks.en: The recorded software stack is PyTorch 2.14.0 with CUDA 13.0, Transformers 5.17.0, Datasets 5.0.1, Safetensors 0.8.0 and NumPy 2.2.6. Nineteen of the original 1,242 runs predate a cluster upgrade and used PyTorch 2.5.1 with CUDA 12.1. Two belong to reported cells; rerunning them on the newer version changed their scores by − 0.16 -0.16 and + 0.65 +0.65 points. The exact association between versions and runs requires the per-run manifests.
blocks.zh: 所记录的软件堆栈为PyTorch 2.14.0,配有CUDA 13.0,变形器 5.1.7.0, Dataset 5.0, Safetensors 6.8.0和NumPy 2.2.6. 原有的1,242个中,有19个运行在集群升级之前,并使用带有CUDA 12.1的PyTorch 2.5.1. 两个属于被报道的细胞;在较新版本上重新运行它们时,它们的分数被改变为−0.16-0.16和+0.65+0.65分. 版本和运行之间的确切关联需要每个运行的运算表.

blocks.en: The reported accounting is 1,242 original runs (256 GPU-hours), 539 later runs (179 GPU-hours) and 838 extension runs (116.1 GPU-hours): 2,619 training runs and approximately 551 GPU-hours. This includes selection and follow-up work beyond the reduced set of comparisons emphasized in this manuscript. It excludes failed or superseded runs and substantial non-training work such as SVD caches, some gradient measurements and evaluation. The broader exploratory project reports 6,545 completed executions and 1,069 GPU-hours, using an execution-based count that is not directly interchangeable with the campaign count. The first follow-up campaigns add 681 runs and 61.3 GPU-hours: boundary selection 24/3.4, single GPU model 35/5.0, PEFT MiCA 15/0.8, shared recipe 5/0.2, module groups 538/45.9, and warm-up seeds 64/6.0 (runs/hours). The random-A replication adds 53 runs and 5.2 GPU-hours (36 selection, 2 extension, 15 reporting), bringing the campaign-based total to 3,353 training runs and approximately 617.6 GPU-hours. The post hoc audits launch no training runs. These totals include research and selection costs, not just the cost of any one adapter.
